title: DistilT: Compact Translation Models via Conditioned Distillation (SYNTHETIC)

paragraphs.text: We present DistilT, a compact translation model distilled from TransB, and evaluate it on LowMT100 under a low-resource budget.
TransA and DistilT both target low-resource translation, but no direct comparison between them has been reported.
DistilT is trained by knowledge distillation from TransB on the LowMT100 training split of 10,000 sentence pairs.
TransB-ft, a fine-tuned variant of TransB for the medical domain, is outside the scope of this evaluation.
On LowMT100, DistilT achieves 31.0 BLEU and TransB achieves 30.5 BLEU under the low-resource condition; DistilT outperforms TransB by 0.5 BLEU.
